card.name: Scattered words in survival or emergency text
card.fires_on: No single word type. It fires on scattered small words such as 'of', 'to', 'the' or a decimal point, often in disaster, emergency or survival text.

modes.label: Small linking words
modes.description: Short words like 'of', 'to' or 'the' in the middle of a clause.
modes.example: During World War II about 65%<< of>> the town were destroyed.

modes.label: Emergency instruction words
modes.description: Verbs or nouns in first-aid or preparedness lists.
modes.example: Lightning victims do not 'carry a charge' and are safe to<< touch>>.
